filename: Understanding and Visualizing Droplet Distributions in Simulations of Shallow Clouds.pdf
title: Understanding and Visualizing Droplet Distributions in Simulations of Shallow Clouds
testbed_rationale: The 3D bin microphysical LES simulation dataset is not provided with an open repository or public access link in the paper, making it unusable as an immediate benchmark/testbed dataset without contacting authors.
pain_points: High dimensionality of spectral bin microphysics datasets (3D space, time, and 33 droplet size bins) makes visualization and analysis challenging.
Standard clustering algorithms struggle with the sheer volume and continuous nature of LES spectral bin data.
extraction_notes: The paper uses an unsupervised VAE to compress 33-bin cloud droplet size distributions down to a 3D latent space for continuous color visualization and analysis of aerosol-cloud interactions and precipitation initiation, rather than learning a predictive parameterization directly.
